physics.formula: u_oil = current_drift_factor*uo + wind_drift_factor*u10; v_oil = current_drift_factor*vo + wind_drift_factor*v10

nan_coastline_policy.fallback: 3x3 then 5x5 inverse-distance-weighted valid-ocean neighbors, minimum 4 valid neighbors, weight=1/(d^2+epsilon)
nan_coastline_policy.land_source: static CMEMS uo/vo NaN mask (verified time-invariant across all 96 forcing timesteps)

hotspots.logic: (active particles inside critical polygon)/(active particles) >= 30% -> CRITICAL; elif (.../active) >= 30% of watch polygon -> WATCH; else CLEAR (user-directed change, post-F07, from the originally locked 'any particle' rule)

openoil_validation.primary_residual_cause: spherical-Earth displacement approximation (iste.geometry) vs OpenDrift's WGS84-ellipsoidal geodesic forward calculation

known_limitations: Hotspot alert logic uses a user-directed 30% minimum-fraction-of-active-particles rule (per zone), requested and applied after the original F00-F07 pilot completed -- this is a deliberate, documented deviation from README section 10's originally locked 'any single particle triggers the zone' rule (CLAUDE.md section 13 requires such deviations be documented, not silent; see progress.md's post-F07 revision entry). Both fractions are configurable via fwd.hotspots.HotspotThresholds.

Spherical-Earth displacement approximation (iste.geometry.metres_to_degrees) vs OpenDrift's WGS84-ellipsoidal pyproj.Geod -- identified as the primary source of the small (<1%) OpenOil comparison residual; not fixed, per this project's reuse-Stage-III policy.

This specific case's real 72h run never triggers NEIGHBOR_FALLBACK or LAND_STRANDED (the slick stays over 60 km offshore throughout) -- those code paths were validated separately against synthetic/boundary points in F01-F03, not exercised end-to-end here.
Land classification source is the static CMEMS uo/vo NaN mask (~4.6 km grid resolution), not an independent coastline shapefile (none exists in this project's environment).
No frontend/application exists anywhere in this workspace to consume these outputs (confirmed by a dedicated search in F05); outputs are standalone files for now.

CLAUDE.md/README's documented forcing paths (data/ocean.nc, files/28th_june/wind.nc) still do not match the actual paths used throughout F01-F07 (data/28th_april/ocean.nc, data/28th_april/wind.nc) -- flagged since F00, docs not yet updated.
